description: Top-level index that cross-references every extracted Fusion 360 CAM module (2D operations, 3D operations, multiaxis, turning). Consumed by Fusion360FunctionIndexEngine for lookup, dependency tracing, and AI orchestration.

modules.description: 2D Adaptive, 2D Pocket, 2D Contour, Face, Slot, Trace, Engrave, Thread, Bore, Circular, Chamfer
Adaptive Clearing 3D, Pocket Clearing, Parallel, Contour, Steep and Shallow, Scallop, Pencil, Morphed Spiral, Radial, Spiral, Project
Swarf, Multi-Axis Contour, Flow, Rotary, Multi-Axis Pocket, Blade, Impeller
Turning Profile Roughing/Finishing, Face, Thread, Groove, Cutoff, Bore, Secondary Spindle, Live Tooling
Legacy comprehensive catalog with 3D, multiaxis, turning, probing and API surface
Detailed 2D toolpath parameter enumeration with all tabs and parameter metadata
Probing toolpaths — WCS setup (8 ops), geometry inspection (sphere + hole pattern), tool measurement (length/diameter/breakage), in-process inspection (3 ops). Renishaw OMP/RMP-compatible.

Additive manufacturing toolpaths — DED (4 ops: thin-wall, wide-area, multi-axis lattice, repair), PBF/SLM (3 ops: part, support, lattice infill), FDM (3 ops: part, support, infill pattern), Hybrid (2 ops: cycled DED+mill, near-net+finish). Manufacturing Extension surface.

Sheet cutting toolpaths — laser cutting (3 ops: cutting, etching, drilling), waterjet (3 ops: abrasive, pure-water, 5-axis tapered), plasma (3 ops: cutting, bevel, mark). 9 toolpaths covering 2D contour with kerf compensation, lead-in/out, pierce strategies.

Inspection-extension toolpaths — CMM planning + sampling strategy (2 ops), tolerance stack analysis RSS + Monte Carlo + surface form + compare-to-CAD (4 ops), GD&T validate / zone-check + probe compensation calibrate (3 ops), inspection report + certificate of conformance (2 ops). 11 toolpaths complementing MS1-01 Probing — focuses on planning, analysis, validation, and reporting layers above raw probe macros.

Mill-turn toolpaths — synchronization (4 ops: turning_transfer, part_catcher, mill_turn_sync, bar_feed_advance), auxiliary (2 ops: tailstock, steady_rest), C-axis (2 ops: indexed mill, interpolated mill), multi-axis (4 ops: Y-axis offcenter turning, polygon turning, thread whirling, cross-drilling live). 12 toolpaths covering true dual-channel mill-turn capability for Integrex/NTX/CTX-class machines.

Manufacturing-model / setup primitives — workpiece (5 ops: stock from model, from previous setup, from body, from box, from cylinder), fixture (2 ops: vise, chuck), coordinates (2 ops: WCS_DEFINE single G54-G59, WCS_OFFSET_SCHEDULE extended G54.1 P1..P48), kinematics (1 op: machine + post + axis-config bind), multi-setup (1 op: Op1/Op2 group with datum propagation), documentation (1 op: setup-sheet PDF/HTML/image bundle). 12 toolpaths anchoring every downstream module to a concrete machine + workpiece + datum frame.

2D milling per-op tab deep pass — closes the input-exhaust gap on existing 2d-operations.json by adding 4 previously-uncatalogued tabs (Strategy, Ramp, Holder, Output, plus Connections) to the 11 existing 2D ops via _DEEP entries (Adaptive/Pocket/Contour/Chamfer/Face/Slot/Trace/Engrave/Bore/Circular/Thread), AND introduces 4 net-new drill-family ops (DRILL_2D with 12 cycle codes, TAP_2D rigid+floating, REAM_2D G85, COUNTERBORE_2D G82). 15 toolpaths total. Brings Fusion 360 2D milling toward 100% input-field coverage per L2-CAMX-EXHAUST mandate.

3D milling per-op tab deep pass — closes the input-exhaust gap on existing 3d-operations.json by adding 5 previously-uncatalogued tabs (Strategy, Ramp, Holder, Output, Connections) to the 12 existing 3D ops via _DEEP entries (Adaptive/Pocket/Parallel/Contour 3D + Scallop/Pencil/Radial/Spiral/Morphed-Spiral/Steep-Shallow/Horizontal/Ramp), AND introduces 2 net-new finishing ops (PROJECT_3D for sketch-curve projection onto curved surfaces, FLAT_3D for auto-detected flat-surface finishing). 14 toolpaths total. Note: 8 simpler-finishing _DEEP ops also fill in missing Heights/Linking tabs that the parent catalog omitted.

Multiaxis per-op tab deep pass — closes the input-exhaust gap on existing multiaxis-operations.json by adding 5 standard deep tabs (Strategy, Ramp, Holder, Output, Connections) to the 7 existing multiaxis ops via _DEEP entries (Swarf / Multi-Axis Contour / Flow / Morphed-Spiral-Multiaxis / Rotary-4axis / Trimming / Impeller-Machining), AND introduces 2 net-new ops (BLADE_5AX for turbine-blade-specific 5-axis finishing with leading/trailing-edge blend, MULTI_AXIS_POCKET for 5-axis adaptive pocket roughing with tilt-to-avoid). 9 toolpaths total. The 5 simpler _DEEP ops also fill in missing Heights/Linking tabs the parent catalog omitted. Adds RTCP (G43.4 Runtime Tool Center Point) output controls to every op for proper 5-axis NC output.
